adaptations: JS and Arista use official purs 0.15.16; package fetching does not compile with the local TAST fork.
Reference loops use tailRecM for stack safety on every compiled backend.
psgo uses a workspace-local UTF-16 CodeUnits.length correction; upstream go-ffi is unchanged.
Go FFI private helper names are unique per case and variant because the backend combines foreign sources.
